abstract_sentences.text: Multi-view clustering (MVC) aims to group unlabeled data into semantically meaningful clusters by leveraging cross-view consistency.

evidence.anchor: Multi-view clustering (MVC) aims to group unlabeled data into semantically meaningful clusters by leveraging cross-view consistency

abstract_sentences.text: However, real-world datasets collected from the web often suffer from noisy correspondence (NC), which breaks the consistency prior and results in unreliable alignments.

evidence.anchor: However, real-world datasets collected from the web often suffer from noisy correspondence (NC), which breaks the consistency prior and results in unreliable alignments

abstract_sentences.qualifiers_and_numbers: 限定为常见 web-collected 场景。
abstract_sentences.transition: However 将任务转为现实失配。

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we identify two critical forms of NC that particularly harm clustering: i) category-level mismatch, where semantically consistent samples from the same class are mistakenly treated as negatives; and ii) sample-level mismatch, where collected cross-view pairs are misaligned and some samples may even lack any valid counterpart.
abstract_sentences.transition: 把一般 NC 拆成两种机制。

abstract_sentences.text: To address these challenges, we propose CorreGen, a generative framework that formulates noisy correspondence learning in MVC as maximum likelihood estimation over underlying cross-view correspondences.

evidence.anchor: To address these challenges, we propose CorreGen, a generative framework that formulates noisy correspondence learning in MVC as maximum likelihood estimation over underlying cross-view correspondences

abstract_sentences.qualifiers_and_numbers: To address 指明因果承接。

abstract_sentences.text: The objective is elegantly solved via an Expectation–Maximization algorithm: in the E-step, soft correspondence distributions are inferred across views, capturing class-level relations while adaptively down-weighting noisy or unalignable samples through GMM-guided marginals; in the M-step, the embedding network is updated to maximize the expected log-likelihood.
abstract_sentences.transition: 展开 CorreGen 的 E/M 两步。

abstract_sentences.text: Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world noisy datasets demonstrate that our method significantly improves clustering robustness.

evidence.anchor: Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world noisy datasets demonstrate that our method significantly improves clustering robustness

abstract_sentences.qualifiers_and_numbers: 代码可用性；schema 没有 availability 枚举。

abstract_summary.reported_result: Qualitative robustness improvement only; no metric, data set, baseline, or uncertainty in the abstract.
abstract_summary.strongest_claim_position: Sentence 6, after the E/M mechanism and before code availability.

method_moves.unit: 现有 instance-level contrastive pair construction。
从 marginal likelihood 到 all-pair joint likelihood。
many-to-many correspondence 与较弱 given-pair dependence。
cluster size plus Mahalanobis confidence marginal。
entropy-regularized augmented OT and Sinkhorn scaling。
P*/marginal posterior Q weighted similarity likelihood。

method_summary.formal_objects: Views x_i^(v), encoder fθ, embeddings z_i^(v), C clusters, pair indicator t_ij, latent counterpart posterior Q, coupling P/P~, marginals p^(v), virtual mass ρ.
method_summary.input_output_state: Input is a multi-view data set with noisy observed pairings; E-step produces soft cross-view correspondence distributions; M-step updates encoder parameters θ.
method_summary.objective: All-pair joint likelihood Eq. (3), approximated with an EM lower bound Eq. (5)–(8).

component_to_problem.GMM-guided marginals: assigns lower mass to less coherent/outlier samples and reflects cluster size
component_to_problem.entropy-regularized OT: provides a soft many-to-many coupling with specified marginals
component_to_problem.M-step Q weighting: uses inferred rather than given correspondence

algorithms.note: No Algorithm environment/pseudocode or asymptotic Big-O; Proposition 1 calls the Sinkhorn scaling procedure efficient.

method_summary.theory_role: The core EM/OT derivation is causal to the algorithm; Proposition 1 is a solver guarantee, Proposition 2 is explanatory unification, Appendix G is a qualified convergence guarantee, and Appendix H is diagnostic.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将 noisy correspondence 重写为对未观测跨视角 correspondence 的 MLE，再以 GMM marginal、virtual sample 和 entropy-regularized OT 估计 soft posterior，并用 M-step 学 robust representation。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 问题分类、Eq. (1)–(19) 的核心 EM/OT 链、两项 Proposition 的陈述、主设置、Tables 1–2 与 Figure 3。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: proof、实现和数据细节、MR/CR 曲线、参数敏感性、消融、收敛、CMR 与噪声案例均迁入 Appendix A–J；附录 7 页。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 与 Eq. (9)–(18) 的同构机制图，加上 Table 1 的跨 MR/数据集/指标矩阵和 Appendix B 的假设—化简证明。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 类别级 correspondence 的直接验证只有 mini-batch heatmap，缺 quantitative recovery metric；主表缺 dispersion/testing，Table 2 也有局部不胜。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 鲁棒机制的每个组件应在公式中有明确职责，并在同一受控噪声条件下给出主性能、组件删除和直接机制读出。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 若 latent relation 没有可信 ground truth 或可控干预，热图只能提供定性结构证据，不能替代机制识别。
final_judgment.theory_boundary: Proposition 1 是 entropy-regularized OT 子问题的 solver 结论；Proposition 2 依赖 uniform/degenerate 条件；Appendix G 只说明其给定 EM 边界下的 stationary point。
